DB additionally holds 104-135 (AR 20, SAR 10, 134/135 rarity empty) and B/G/R Mew: 35 cards, all tcgdex-ja and pending, not in the official search list. 151/152 = the one official LEGEND page with two numbers; DAR/FIG/FIR/GRA/LIG/MET/PSY/WAT = official numberless energies.

M6.interpretation: Official has 3 stadium pages that print two numbers each (071/076 left, 072/076 right; verified on page 50409); DB holds 071-076 as six cards. Consistent, no real difference.
